name: Captain Marra
dialogue: Welcome to Starforge Station. Pick a destination and I will arrange passage.

name: Lucy
dialogue: Three worlds, one shared sky. Talk to Iona in Mosslight; her observatory needs a crystal from Cinder-7.

name: Iona
dialogue: Our observatory can connect the colonies. Can you bring one amethyst shard from Cinder-7? Ask Sera near the landing pad.

name: Sera
dialogue: Iona sent you? Take a crystal from our survey. The colonies should share what they discover.

name: Arlen
dialogue: Aurora Reach is yours to explore and build in. The landing pad always leads back to Starforge Station.

name: Mira
dialogue: Welcome to Harborlight! Our biggest export is awkward introductions. Dr Pip at the east workshop has a rocket for you. Go meet the universe; bring back friends, not a conquest.

name: Dr Pip
dialogue: Rocket science is mostly making sure the pointy bit has ambition. I have a starter hull and a spacesuit for you. Build on the east pad, capture your design, then fly above Y 280 into space. No part budget. Your ship cannot be damaged.

name: Fern
dialogue: The trees are excellent listeners. Also acceptable landing pads. Please avoid the one I just watered.

name: Toast
dialogue: One day I will end a war with soup. Until then: packed lunches, friendship, and no eating your rocket parts.

name: Bolt
dialogue: Welcome to the world of endless possibility! We saved you a berth. The flight test ends here; your adventures do not. Go make friends out there.

name: Dr Jun
dialogue: Your suit handles space forever. Underwater you still need to breathe. The ship floats up unless the ceiling disagrees.

name: Ada
dialogue: We dock rockets, egos, and occasionally a very confused cow. Land anywhere; this station belongs to all of us.

name: Sol
dialogue: A galaxy can have battles without making conquest the goal. Listen, help, invite people along. The greatest victory will be an invasion that becomes a conversation.
